"**RF0–RF1 do not edit `src/gnd`.**" and "Under RF-D2, RF0 and RF1 may run now." Section 8 states the plan gate has not happened yet: "The next step is plan review and the owner plan gate."

evidence.location: Section 4, RF0 body; Section 5 table, last row
evidence.observation: RF0 must "Record the unit handoff in `migration/units.json`, and update the test that currently requires every unit to be source-owned", and Section 5 assigns "`tests/test_public_distribution.py`, distribution manifest | Update procedure decided in RF-D3. | RF0". The plan never gives the repository-relative path of `migration/units.json` or the distribution manifest, and Section 2 shows other referenced records do live under `src/gnd` ("`src/gnd/skills/gnd-orm-core/references/milestone-record-format.md`").

If any is, either move that RF0 deliverable behind the RF-D2 sign-offs or record an explicit owner exemption, and rewrite the header sentence so the preconditions for a src/gnd edit are non-circular (plan gate plus RF-D2 sign-offs, with the RF0 handoff record named as an RF0 output rather than a precondition).

evidence.observation: "**Thin entry points:** `cli.py` is a dispatcher over `commands/<group>.py` modules, and no command handler holds domain logic that `api.py` or a lane `service.py` cannot also reach." No criterion in RF5 tests the second clause.

"RF5-C3 `cli.py` shrinks to at most the line budget the spec declares." The bound is chosen by the document that is being gated, and the plan sets no floor, no reduction ratio and no owner approval requirement for it, against a re-measured baseline of "`cli.py` 9,088".

"RF5-C1 the RF1 parser, help and exit pins are unchanged. RF5-C2 tests that require `gnd.cli` to stay unloaded also cover `gnd.commands.*`. RF5-C3 ... RF5-C4 every monkeypatch of a moved name targets the new location." None of the four instruments predicate 4's dispatcher/domain-logic claim.

concerns.recommendation: Give predicate 4 an instrument: an absolute plan-level ceiling or required reduction ratio for `cli.py` measured by the RF0 tool and approved at the owner gate, plus a named check for the domain-logic clause (a test asserting each moved handler's logic is reachable from `api.py` or a lane `service.py`, or a per-handler reachability table committed in the RF5 spec and reviewed at its gate).
concerns.title: Completion predicate 4 cannot be demonstrated: RF5-C3's budget is self-declared and the domain-logic clause has no criterion

evidence.observation: "every `monkeypatch` of a moved name is re-pointed at the new location in the same phase" and "Tests that scan source text (`inspect.getsource`, reads of `cli.py`, "module stays unloaded" checks) are widened to cover each new module in the same phase. summary: The plan is MVP-ordered, pins behavior before moves (RF-R3/RF1), separates move-only diffs (RF-R4), and defers tightening to RF7 under RF-D7. Two gates are not demonstrable as written: the src/gnd edit gate that authorizes RF0 now is circular and never states whether migration/units.json or the distribution manifest live under src/gnd, and completion predicate 4 (thin entry points) has no instrument because RF5-C3 defers its line budget to the spec and no criterion covers the domain-logic clause. Several further criteria are self-set (RF2-C2, RF3-C2, RF6-C1), scope-less (RF4-C2, RF1 layering test, RF8-C2 territory), keyed to audit numbers the plan says were not re-proved (RF4-C3), or omit phase obligations that RF-R5/RF-R6 make binding (monkeypatch re-pointing and source-scan widening outside RF5).
